# llm-cost-benchmark

> Open-source LLM cost benchmark RUNNER: send any model through real agentic tasks, track actual billed API spend per turn, hard-stop at a USD budget. Example finding (Sep 2026): the same 6-turn agent job cost $0.0018 on the cheapest model vs $0.14 on the most expensive (77×).

## What this is

A reproducible open-source LLM cost benchmark runner (PowerShell, any OpenAI-compatible endpoint; OpenRouter by default). Presets define task, turns, models, and a USD budget kill-switch; results append to CSV and render on the live report. Also contains a published example run: seven frontier models (GLM-5.3-flash, GPT-5.6-luna, DeepSeek V4 Pro, Kimi K2, Claude Sonnet 5, Claude Opus 5, Qwen3-235B) ran identical workloads: a single Q&A prompt and a full 6-turn agentic loop, with per-turn cumulative cost extracted from API billing responses.

## Key findings (Sep 22, 2026)

- GLM-5.3-flash completed the same 6-turn agent job for $0.0018; Claude Opus 5 cost $0.14 — a **77× cost gap** for equivalent output.
- Open-weight models only: GLM flash was still **15.5× cheaper** than Qwen3-235B.
- **Cheap-per-token ≠ cheap-per-task.** Qwen3-235B had a low token price but generated thousands of tokens per turn, finishing 15.5× more expensive. Claude Opus 5 had disciplined turns but a rate so high it landed 77× above flash.
- Agentic workloads compound verbosity: each turn re-reads prior context, so talkative models pay their verbosity tax with interest every turn.
- Practical rule: budget agent workloads by **cost-per-completed-task**, never price-per-million-tokens.

## Machine-readable results

- `data/results.csv`, `data/agentic_results.csv`, `data/agentic_results_open.csv` — legacy Sep 22 run files (these also carry a `cum_cost_php` column)
- `data/preset_runs.csv` — runs from the preset runner (appended automatically; USD is always recorded; optional extra currency column via `-CurrencyCode`/`-CurrencyRate`)

CSV columns: legacy agentic files: timestamp, model, turn, prompt_tokens, completion_tokens, cum_prompt_tokens, cum_cost_usd, cum_cost_php. preset_runs.csv: timestamp, preset, model, turn, prompt_tokens, completion_tokens, cum_cost_usd, budget_usd, outcome, checks_passed.

## Headline numbers (quick reference)

| Model | 6-turn agent total (USD) | × cheapest |
|---|---|---|
| z-ai/glm-5.3-flash | 0.0018 | 1× |
| openai/gpt-5.6-luna | 0.0056 | 3.1× |
| deepseek/deepseek-v4-pro-0813 | 0.0155 | 8.5× |
| anthropic/claude-sonnet-5 | 0.0449 | 24.6× |
| anthropic/claude-opus-5 | 0.1400 | 76.6× |

## Re-run the benchmark

```powershell
$env:OPENAI_API_KEY = 'sk-...'      # environment only; runner refuses exposed keys
.\scripts\run_benchmark.ps1 -Preset general
```

Presets: `general` (quick run, all models), `agentic-web-app`, `agentic-data-analysis`, `tool-heavy`.
Quick-test any new model: `.\scripts\run_benchmark.ps1 -Preset general -Models 'vendor/new-model-id'`.
